Maduro Shares Photos from US Detention Facility

Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro has shared photographs of himself from a US detention facility. The images show Maduro inside what appears to be a prison, where he is seen flashing peace signs. He stated, "Venezuela will be reborn" and "We are standing firm" from his detention. These are the first photos released since his capture.
